author.en-US: Jean-Joseph Gaume, translated by F. B. Jamison
author.pt-BR: Jean-Joseph Gaume, traduzido por F. B. Jamison

description.en-US: Abbé Gaume's Petit catéchisme de persévérance in the Rev. F. B. Jamison's English: a historical, doctrinal, moral and liturgical exposition of the Catholic religion in short questions and answers, in four courses of some fifty chapters each. Course 1 covers creation, man, the fall and the prophecies; Course 2 the life of Christ and the Creed; Course 3 the history of the Church; Course 4 worship, the Mass and the liturgical year.
description.pt-BR: O Petit catéchisme de persévérance do Abbé Gaume no inglês do Rev. F. B. Jamison: uma exposição histórica, doutrinal, moral e litúrgica da religião católica em perguntas e respostas curtas, em quatro cursos de cerca de cinquenta capítulos cada. O Curso 1 trata da criação, do homem, da queda e das profecias; o Curso 2 da vida de Cristo e do Credo; o Curso 3 da história da Igreja; o Curso 4 do culto, da Missa e do ano litúrgico.

sources.description: The Catechism of Perseverance, trans. Rev. F. B. Jamison, fiftieth edition, revised and enlarged (Boston: Thomas Noonan; first edition 1850), via the archive.org OCR text (University of Toronto scan). Tier A: public domain in the United States (a nineteenth-century text). Uncorrected OCR beyond systematic fixes (running heads, spacing, line-end hyphens restored by dictionary); questions are numbered per chapter by this edition's markup, not by the source.
